build_TdsNetwork: build a TdsNetwork with Conv1dBlock and TdsStage layers to process EMG signals into pose features
create_NeuroPose: create a NeuroPose encoder-decoder network with residual blocks to predict hand pose from EMG data
build_MLP_decoder: build an MLP decoder with configurable layer sizes and optional layer normalization to map features to outputs
create_SequentialLSTM: create a SequentialLSTM that processes one time step at a time and maintains hidden state across calls
review_TdsStage: review the TdsStage class that combines Conv1dBlock and TDSConvEncoder for temporal feature extraction
